name: meeting-transcript
description: Classify meeting transcripts or transcript chunks: type, whether decisions or owned action items exist. Send only 'extract' items to Claude for summarization.

meeting_type.instructions: What type of meeting is this transcript from?

criteria.status_standup: Recurring status update, standup, or check-in
criteria.planning_decision: Planning, prioritization, design review, or a meeting held to make a decision
criteria.incident_review: Outage response, incident bridge, or postmortem
criteria.customer_external: Call with a customer, vendor, candidate, or other external party
criteria.social_other: Social chat, all-hands broadcast, or content with no working agenda

has_decision.instructions: Did the participants explicitly agree on a decision (not merely discuss options)?

has_owned_action.instructions: Is there at least one action item assigned to a named person, with that person accepting it?

has_risk.instructions: Did anyone raise a risk, blocker, missed deadline, or escalation that leadership would want to know about?
